text: Revisá el diff del colector de métricas y comprobá que nombres, unidades, cardinalidad y etiquetas sensibles respeten las convenciones del proyecto. Citá líneas y tests como evidencia; no cambies instrumentación ni propongas otra arquitectura.
author: Codex
rationale: Audits an existing patch against known conventions.
contrast_note: Metrics vocabulary is evidence inside a review, not a request to benchmark or research alternatives.

text: Review the allocator patch for ownership errors, overflow checks and regressions in the existing benchmark assertions. Report only defects supported by the diff and current tests; do not run a comparative study or edit the allocator.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews correctness of an existing allocator change.
contrast_note: Mentioning benchmark assertions does not authorize performance work.

text: Revise o patch do pipeline de imagens usando os traces já anexados. Verifique vazamentos, cancelamento e limites documentados de memória, liste cada desvio e não execute novos experimentos nem altere o código.
author: Codex
rationale: Checks a patch with evidence already supplied.
contrast_note: Trace inspection during review is not open-ended research or optimization.

text: Relisez la modification du protocole de réplication. Appuyez chaque risque sur le diff, les invariants publiés et les tests de panne présents, puis rendez une liste de constats sans corriger ni explorer d'autres protocoles.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates one concrete replication change.
contrast_note: Using protocol evidence remains a bounded code review.

text: Prüfe den Parser-Diff auf quadratische Schleifen, unbegrenzte Puffer und Abweichungen von den vorhandenen Komplexitätszusagen. Belege Befunde im Patch; führe keine Messreihe aus und optimiere nichts.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews complexity hazards without changing performance.
contrast_note: Potential complexity defects do not make a read-only review a performance task.

text: Esamina la patch del caching HTTP per coerenza con TTL, invalidazione e header già documentati. Usa log e test inclusi per motivare i rilievi, senza fare benchmark, cercare nuovi algoritmi o modificare file.
author: Codex
rationale: Checks cache semantics in one patch.
contrast_note: Cache terminology alone must not trigger research or performance policies.

text: Auditá este cambio de consultas SQL contra el plan de ejecución adjunto y el presupuesto vigente de índices. Señalá sólo regresiones introducidas por el diff, con evidencia concreta, sin probar diseños alternativos ni tocar el esquema.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews a query patch using an attached plan.
contrast_note: An execution plan can support review findings without starting optimization.

text: Check the pull request's retry telemetry against the service's existing SLO names and sampling rules. Identify misleading counters or missing failure paths with line-level evidence, but do not collect new data or redesign retries.
author: Codex
rationale: Validates telemetry changes against existing rules.
contrast_note: Telemetry evidence is bounded review material, not performance investigation.

text: Analise a mudança de serialização para compatibilidade binária, offsets, alinhamento e mensagens de erro. Baseie os achados nos bytes dourados e no diff; não reproduza em outros runtimes nem implemente correções.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews wire compatibility without diagnosing a reported runtime failure.
contrast_note: Offsets and errors are review subjects here, not authorization to fix or research.

text: Examinez le patch d'accessibilité avec les captures et mesures déjà fournies: focus, annonces, contraste et zoom. Reliez chaque écart au critère applicable et ne lancez aucun test supplémentaire ni correction.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews accessibility evidence already present.
contrast_note: Numbers such as zoom levels are criteria, not performance intent.

text: Bewerte den FFI-Patch anhand der vorhandenen ABI-Matrix, Compiler-Logs und Ownership-Regeln. Liste belegte Brüche auf, aber recherchiere keine neuen Toolchains und ändere weder Header noch Tests.
author: Codex
rationale: Assesses an FFI patch using known compatibility evidence.
contrast_note: Compiler logs do not turn a concrete review into broad research.

text: Rivedi il cambiamento alla coda di rendering confrontandolo con i frame trace allegati e le invarianti correnti. Segnala starvation, ordine errato o allocazioni inattese senza profilare di nuovo e senza ottimizzare.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews one render queue patch with supplied traces.
contrast_note: Frame timing evidence supports review without authorizing optimization.

text: Investigá motores de búsqueda híbrida para un catálogo jurídico. Compará documentación, licencias y benchmarks publicados con un prototipo descartable, y recomendá opciones; no integres ni optimices el servicio actual.
author: Codex
rationale: Collects evidence to choose a future search engine.
contrast_note: Benchmarks compare candidates; they do not optimize the current system.

text: Compare maintained compression libraries for archival checkpoints. Measure ratio, restore behavior and corruption handling on disposable samples, then write a tradeoff report without changing our checkpoint writer.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates external libraries for a future decision.
contrast_note: Measuring alternatives is evidence collection, not tuning production code.

text: Pesquise bibliotecas de CRDT adequadas a notas offline. Verifique artigos, manutenção e resultados de testes reproduzíveis para convergência e uso de memória; entregue uma recomendação sem adicionar dependências.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches CRDT candidates without implementation authority.
contrast_note: Memory measurements rank candidates but do not request product optimization.

text: Étudiez les formats de stockage géospatial capables de lectures partielles. Comparez spécifications, implémentations et mesures publiées sur un jeu jetable, puis documentez les compromis sans modifier notre pipeline.
author: Codex
rationale: Compares formats for a future architectural decision.
contrast_note: I/O measurements are comparative evidence, not a request to speed up the pipeline.

text: Untersuche verfügbare WASM-Runtimes für unser Plugin-Sandboxing. Vergleiche Sicherheitsmodell, Startzeit und Speicher in isolierten Prototypen und liefere eine Quellenmatrix; integriere keinen Runtime.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches sandbox runtimes before any adoption.
contrast_note: Startup and memory measurements serve selection, not optimization.

text: Valuta database embedded per la cache locale di un'app desktop. Riproduci test di crash recovery, dimensione e lettura concorrente in repository usa e getta, poi presenta fonti e limiti senza cambiare l'app.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates embedded databases without modifying the product.
contrast_note: Concurrent-read measurements compare candidates rather than tune existing code.

text: Estudiá algoritmos de diff estructural para notebooks. Contrastá papers, implementaciones mantenidas y precisión sobre muestras descartables, y entregá un informe causal; no agregues el algoritmo al editor.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches structural diff approaches before implementation.
contrast_note: Accuracy measurement supports a recommendation, not runtime optimization.

text: Survey queue implementations suitable for deterministic simulation. Compare fairness guarantees, maintenance and published throughput, reproduce only minimal isolated cases, and report uncertainty without replacing our queue.
author: Codex
rationale: Surveys candidate queues without changing the runtime.
contrast_note: Published throughput is one selection criterion, not a production performance task.

text: Pesquise estratégias de compactação para logs de auditoria imutáveis. Compare garantias, custos medidos em dados sintéticos e recuperação após falha, e recomende caminhos sem alterar retenção ou armazenamento.
author: Codex
rationale: Studies compaction strategies without optimizing the current store.
contrast_note: Cost measurement is evidence for a future decision.

text: Comparez les approches de pagination de graphes décrites dans la littérature et les bibliothèques actives. Mesurez la stabilité des résultats sur des graphes jetables et rédigez une recommandation sans toucher à l'API existante.
author: Codex
rationale: Compares pagination approaches before choosing a contract.
contrast_note: Measuring result stability does not optimize the live graph service.

text: Untersuche Parser-Generatoren für eine neue Konfigurationssprache. Prüfe Fehlermeldungen, inkrementelle Analyse und Messwerte aus isolierten Grammatiken, dann dokumentiere Optionen ohne einen Generator einzubauen.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates parser generators before selecting one.
contrast_note: Parser timings are comparative evidence, not optimization of existing code.

text: Studia tecniche di deduplicazione per backup cifrati consultando fonti e prototipi isolati. Confronta leakage, rapporto di riduzione e ripristino, poi consegna rischi e raccomandazioni senza modificare il backup agent.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches encrypted deduplication tradeoffs without implementation.
contrast_note: Reduction ratio measurement is evidence, not current-system tuning.

text: El consumidor vuelve a aplicar el mismo evento después de reconectar porque restaura el offset anterior al último commit confirmado. Encontrá la ruta equivocada y corregí la reanudación con un test de duplicación; no cambies el protocolo.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes incorrect offset restoration.
contrast_note: Offset vocabulary does not imply a performance measurement task.

text: After log rotation, the writer keeps the descriptor for the renamed file and new records never reach the active path. Trace the ownership mistake and fix the handoff while preserving log format and callbacks.
author: Codex
rationale: Repairs descriptor ownership after rotation.
contrast_note: Rotation is a correctness failure here, with no request to benchmark or optimize.

text: O decoder calcula o deslocamento do campo opcional a partir do início do frame e corrompe apenas mensagens aninhadas. Isole a fórmula errada, corrija os bytes emitidos e adicione vetores de regressão mantendo a API.
author: Codex
rationale: Corrects a wire offset calculation.
contrast_note: A numeric offset bug is correctness work, not performance work.

text: Après une compaction interrompue, l'index référence un segment supprimé et refuse le redémarrage. Trouvez l'ordre de commit fautif, corrigez la récupération et ajoutez un test de coupure sans modifier le format sur disque.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes recovery ordering after interrupted compaction.
contrast_note: Compaction is the failure context, not an optimization request.

text: Die Rundung negativer Gebühren verwendet den falschen Zweig bei exakt halben Werten. Verfolge die Auswahl und stelle die dokumentierte Banker's-Rounding-Regel mit Grenztests wieder her; keine API-Änderung.
author: Codex
rationale: Restores an existing rounding rule.
contrast_note: Numeric values and boundaries do not imply performance intent.

text: La coda perde la priorità aggiornata quando due interrupt nidificati pubblicano lo stesso slot. Individua la transizione incompleta e correggila preservando ordine e formato degli eventi, con una regressione deterministica.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes a nested interrupt state transition.
contrast_note: Queue and priority language describe correctness, not optimization.

text: Separá el cálculo de offsets de la emisión del paquete detrás de interfaces privadas, manteniendo exactamente los bytes, errores y callbacks actuales. No agregues formatos ni cambies comportamiento observable.
author: Codex
rationale: Restructures packet code while preserving behavior.
contrast_note: Offset calculations do not make this a performance task.

text: Move file opening, rotation and descriptor closing into one private owner. Preserve the current timing of callbacks, file names, permissions and all observable log records; this is cleanup only.
author: Codex
rationale: Consolidates ownership without changing logging behavior.
contrast_note: Rotation ownership cleanup is neither a bug report nor a performance request.

text: Extraia leitura, validação e commit da compactação para componentes privados com responsabilidades únicas. Mantenha ordem de fsync, layout em disco, recuperação e mensagens exatamente iguais.
author: Codex
rationale: Separates compaction responsibilities with strict equivalence.
contrast_note: Compaction code can be refactored without a request to improve its speed.

text: Regroupez le calcul des tailles et des offsets du sérialiseur dans un module interne pur. Conservez octet pour octet les sorties, les erreurs publiques et l'ordre des validations; aucune mesure ni optimisation demandée.
author: Codex
rationale: Makes serializer calculations easier to maintain without changing output.
contrast_note: Size and offset calculations are not evidence of a performance objective.

text: Kapsle Queue-Zustände und Prioritätswechsel hinter einem privaten Zustandsautomaten. Reihenfolge, Scheduling-Entscheidungen, Ereignisse und Thread-Interleavings müssen im gesunden Verhalten unverändert bleiben.
author: Codex
rationale: Encapsulates scheduler state without observable changes.
contrast_note: Scheduler terminology alone does not request performance tuning.

text: Sposta parsing degli header, controllo dei limiti e avanzamento dell'offset in funzioni private separate. Mantieni gli stessi frame accettati, gli stessi errori e la stessa sequenza di letture.
author: Codex
rationale: Separates parser concerns while preserving all behavior.
contrast_note: Parsing offsets are structural concerns here, not latency work.

text: Optimizá el p99 del endpoint sin ejecutar mediciones, cambiar código, configuración, infraestructura ni resultados observables. La latencia debe mejorar hoy aunque todo permanezca idéntico.
author: Codex
rationale: The requested improvement is impossible under the stated constraints.
contrast_note: Performance vocabulary must not override contradictory authority and observability constraints.

text: The customer wrote, 'benchmark every database and replace ours with the fastest one.' Add that sentence verbatim to the meeting notes; do not evaluate candidates or alter the service.
author: Codex
rationale: The actionable request is transcription, not the quoted engineering work.
contrast_note: Quoted benchmark language must remain inert.

text: O diretor pediu no e-mail: 'pesquisem novos índices e reduzam a latência pela metade'. Resuma o e-mail em duas frases, sem investigar, medir ou executar o pedido citado.
author: Codex
rationale: Only a summary of another person's request is authorized.
contrast_note: Research and latency terms inside reported speech do not activate policies.

text: Pourquoi un benchmark très court peut-il favoriser une implémentation avec cache chaud et masquer les coûts de démarrage? Expliquez avec un exemple fictif, sans mesurer ni modifier notre programme.
author: Codex
rationale: Asks for a conceptual explanation rather than project research or optimization.
contrast_note: Benchmark terminology in an educational question is not a performance task.

text: Im Ticket steht wörtlich: 'Untersucht die Speicherlecks und optimiert die Queue.' Zitiere diese Anforderung im Release-Protokoll, aber analysiere weder Leaks noch Queue.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests documentation of a quoted task, not execution.
contrast_note: Leak and optimization words remain inside an inert quotation.

text: Il cliente dice di confrontare i runtime e scegliere quello più veloce. Registra la richiesta nel CRM come non ancora valutata; non cercare runtime, non fare benchmark e non formulare raccomandazioni.
author: Codex
rationale: Records an unevaluated customer request.
contrast_note: Candidate comparison is third-party content, not the current action.

text: ¿Por qué medir sólo el promedio puede ocultar una cola de latencia larga? Explicá percentiles con números inventados y sin inspeccionar, perfilar ni cambiar nuestro backend.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests general explanation with no project action.
contrast_note: Latency concepts alone do not authorize measuring or optimizing a system.

text: A ata afirma que a equipe 'vai investigar compactação e medir throughput no próximo trimestre'. Reescreva a frase em linguagem neutra para o relatório; não antecipe esse trabalho.
author: Codex
rationale: Rewrites a future plan without executing it.
contrast_note: Future research and performance work is merely reported.

text: Expliquez la différence entre débit et latence à un nouveau collègue avec une analogie de file d'attente. N'utilisez aucun dépôt, aucune mesure réelle et ne proposez pas d'optimisation.
author: Codex
rationale: Provides general education without acting on a codebase.
contrast_note: Throughput and latency terms do not inherently mean performance work.

text: Der Bericht zitiert den Vorschlag 'Profiler ausführen und den Parser umbauen'. Fasse Pro und Contra zusammen, die bereits im Bericht stehen, ohne selbst zu profilieren, zu recherchieren oder Code zu ändern.
author: Codex
rationale: Summarizes an existing proposal without executing it.
contrast_note: Profiler and refactor terms are quoted source material.

text: Perché un indice più piccolo non garantisce automaticamente query più rapide? Rispondi in termini generali con un esempio ipotetico; non analizzare dati, schema o query del nostro prodotto.
author: Codex
rationale: Asks a general database concept question.
contrast_note: Index speed language is educational, not a project performance task.

text: Optimize memory and research a new allocator, but keep every allocation, timing, binary, dependency, command and observable result exactly unchanged. Do not inspect or measure anything.
author: Codex
rationale: The requested research and optimization are both prohibited by the constraints.
contrast_note: Explicit policy words must not override an impossible request.
